checks.title: Huy Invoice tu pending -> balance hoan lai DAY DU, affiliate nhan email huy
checks.precondition: Affiliate co 1 Invoice dang o trang thai pending, amount = $X.
steps: Ghi lai User.balance hien tai (truoc khi huy).
Bam 'Huy yeu cau' tren dashboard (hoac PUT /invoices/{id} voi status=cancel).
Doc lai Invoice.status va User.balance ngay sau do.
checks.observation_point: Invoice.status, User.balance, va hop thu email cua affiliate.
checks.expected_result: Invoice.status = cancel; User.balance tang lai dung $X (hoan day du); affiliate nhan email 'Yeu cau da bi huy'.

open_question_draft.summary: Oracle STRONG cua check 'CHK-001' hien chi dua tren KB item nguon dev_doc (toan bo KB cua run nay khong co spec_doc/po_dev_confirm/test_case nao).
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Theo luat C5, dev_doc khong duoc la oracle STRONG duy nhat cho check priority P1 (mat du lieu/tien/permission). Ha xuong BASELINE cho toi khi co test_case PASS xac nhan hanh vi, hoac PO/Dev xac nhan truc tiep (po_dev_confirm).

checks.title: Affiliate chi huy duoc khi con pending - nut huy bien mat tu approved tro di
checks.precondition: Affiliate co 1 Invoice da duoc Ops chuyen sang approved.
steps: Dang nhap bang affiliate, mo trang chi tiet/danh sach Invoice da approved.
Quan sat co nut/hanh dong 'Huy yeu cau' nao duoc hien thi cho affiliate khong.
checks.observation_point: Su xuat hien (hoac khong) cua nut huy tren UI affiliate khi Invoice da approved.
checks.expected_result: Nut huy KHONG xuat hien/khong kha dung cho affiliate khi Invoice da chuyen sang approved (hoac trang thai sau do); nut chi hien khi con pending.

open_question_draft.summary: Oracle STRONG cua check 'CHK-002' hien chi dua tren KB item nguon dev_doc (toan bo KB cua run nay khong co spec_doc/po_dev_confirm/test_case nao).
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Theo luat C5, dev_doc khong duoc la oracle STRONG duy nhat cho check priority P1 (mat du lieu/tien/permission). Ha xuong BASELINE cho toi khi co test_case PASS xac nhan hanh vi, hoac PO/Dev xac nhan truc tiep (po_dev_confirm).

checks.title: [KNOWN DEFECT C1 - khong phai expected result] Huy Invoice tu approved KHONG hoan balance tu dong - mat tien thuc
checks.precondition: Invoice da duoc Ops chuyen sang approved (da duyet nhung CHUA thuc su chi tien); affiliate co balance da bi tru ve mot gia tri thap hon do da tao Invoice nay (vd balance = $0 sau khi tao Invoice amount = $120).
steps: Xac nhan Invoice dang o trang thai approved va balance cua affiliate da bi tru tuong ung (vd $0).
Ops huy Invoice nay (chuyen status sang cancel) MA CHUA thuc su chuyen tien thuc ben ngoai.
Doc lai User.balance ngay sau khi huy.
checks.observation_point: User.balance ngay sau khi 1 Invoice approved bi chuyen sang cancel.
checks.expected_result: User.balance KHONG duoc hoan lai tu dong (van giu nguyen gia tri da bi tru, vd van la $0) - DAY LA HANH VI HIEN TAI CUA HE THONG (known defect C1), KHONG PHAI ky vong dung. Co che hoan balance CHI ap dung cho dung nhanh pending->cancel (xem CHK-001). Neu lan chay sau phat hien balance DA duoc hoan tu dong trong tinh huong nay, do la 1 THAY DOI hanh vi can duoc xac nhan lai voi PO/dev truoc khi coi la fix hay regression moi.

open_question_draft.summary: KB item KB-003 mang status=KNOWN_DEFECT da bi go khoi oracle.kb_ids (khong duoc dung lam oracle theo luat C5 'known_defect khong phai expected result'). Check 'CHK-003' hien khong con oracle hop le nao.
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Can PO/Dev xac nhan: hanh vi mo ta trong expected_result la known defect can tiep tuc theo doi (regression-watch, khong oracle) hay can mot kb_id CONFIRMED_EXPECTED khac thay the lam oracle.

checks.title: Quy trinh bu khuyet thu cong: Ops tu tay cong lai balance sau khi huy tu approved (known defect C1)
checks.precondition: Invoice da bi Ops huy tu trang thai approved (nhu CHK-003), balance chua duoc hoan tu dong.
steps: Sau khi xac nhan balance khong duoc hoan tu dong (CHK-003), Ops vao man hinh User cua affiliate.
Ops tu tay cong lai balance dung so tien cua Invoice da bi huy.
Doc lai User.balance sau khi Ops thuc hien dieu chinh.
checks.observation_point: User.balance sau khi Ops thuc hien dieu chinh thu cong.
checks.expected_result: User.balance duoc cong lai dung so tien da mat, khoi phuc dung trang thai truoc khi tao Invoice bi huy - quy trinh thu cong hoat dong nhu tai lieu mo ta (day la quy trinh van hanh, KHONG phai co che tu dong cua he thong).

checks.title: Affiliate thay dung 1 trong 4 trang thai yeu cau thanh toan
checks.precondition: Affiliate co it nhat 1 Invoice o moi trang thai: pending, approved, completed, cancel.
steps: Mo danh sach yeu cau thanh toan cua affiliate.
Quan sat gia tri trang thai hien thi cho moi Invoice.
checks.observation_point: Gia tri trang thai hien thi tren UI cho moi Invoice.
checks.expected_result: Moi Invoice hien thi dung 1 trong 4 gia tri: pending / approved / completed / cancel, khop voi Invoice.status thuc te trong DB.

checks.title: cancellation_reason luu dung ly do huy khi status=cancel
checks.precondition: Invoice sap duoc huy, co nhap ly do huy (neu UI co truong nhap).
steps: Thuc hien huy 1 Invoice, nhap ly do huy cu the (neu co truong nhap).
Doc lai Invoice.cancellation_reason sau khi huy.
checks.observation_point: Gia tri field cancellation_reason tren Invoice sau khi huy.
checks.expected_result: cancellation_reason luu dung noi dung ly do da nhap khi status=cancel; voi Invoice chua bi huy, field nay rong/null.

open_question_draft.summary: Oracle STRONG cua check 'CHK-006' hien trace toi kb_id (KB-006) co confirmation_source.derivation=code_artifact (suy ra tu doc code/schema, khong phai phat bieu nghiep vu tuong minh).
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Theo luat 'phanh derivation' cua C5, STRONG chi hop le khi MOI oracle kb_id deu CONFIRMED_EXPECTED va derivation=prose. Ha xuong BASELINE cho toi khi PO/Dev xac nhan hanh vi nay dung la chu y thiet ke, khong phai tac dung phu cua viec doc code.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Huy Invoice tu trang thai completed - co cho phep khong, balance xu ly the nao
checks.precondition: Invoice da o trang thai completed (da chi tien thuc theo xac nhan cua Ops).
steps: Thu chuyen status cua 1 Invoice completed sang cancel (qua UI hoac PUT /invoices/{id}).
Quan sat ket qua: co thanh cong khong, balance co thay doi khong.
checks.observation_point: Ket qua request va User.balance sau khi thu huy tu completed.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - tai lieu chi neu 2 nhanh pending->cancel va approved->cancel; nhanh completed->cancel chua duoc dinh nghia (co the bam duoc tren UI nhung hau qua chua ro, co nguy co lap lai cung loai defect nhu C1 neu balance bi dong 2 lan hoac khong duoc xu ly).

open_question_draft.summary: Huy 1 Invoice tu trang thai completed co duoc phep khong, va neu duoc, balance/tien da chi duoc xu ly the nao?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Day la nhanh chuyen trang thai duy nhat chua duoc tai lieu hoa; vi da co 1 known defect o nhanh approved->cancel (C1), day la vung rui ro cao can xac nhan truoc khi coi bat ky hanh vi nao la dung.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Affiliate co tu huy duoc Invoice khi da approved (qua goi API truc tiep) hay chi Ops lam duoc
checks.precondition: Affiliate co 1 Invoice da approved; nut huy da an tren UI (theo CHK-002).
steps: Dang nhap bang affiliate, voi Invoice da approved.
Thu goi truc tiep PUT /invoices/{id} voi status=cancel (bo qua UI).
Quan sat ket qua: request co thanh cong khong.
checks.observation_point: HTTP response cua request va Invoice.status/balance sau do.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - tai lieu chi xac nhan nut HUY bien mat tren UI cho affiliate; khong co middleware nao duoc tai lieu hoa rieng cho hanh dong huy (khac voi check_can_create_invoice da duoc xac nhan cho hanh dong TAO). Chua ro affiliate co the tu kich hoat known defect C1 qua API truc tiep hay khong.

open_question_draft.summary: Affiliate co the tu huy 1 Invoice da approved bang cach goi truc tiep PUT /invoices/{id} (bo qua UI da an nut huy) hay bi middleware backend chan giong nhu hanh dong tao Invoice?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Neu affiliate tu kich hoat duoc known defect C1 (mat balance) ma khong can Ops can thiep, muc do nghiem trong va pham vi rui ro se khac han so voi chi Ops gay ra.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Ma tran chuyen trang thai hop le day du cua Invoice - cac chuyen trang thai khac co bi chan khong
checks.precondition: Invoice co the o bat ky trang thai nao trong 4 gia tri: pending/approved/completed/cancel.
steps: Lan luot thu cac chuyen trang thai CHUA duoc tai lieu xac nhan (vd cancel->pending, completed->pending, completed->approved).
Quan sat ket qua tung lan thu.
checks.observation_point: Ket qua (thanh cong/bi chan) cua moi chuyen trang thai thu nghiem.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - tai lieu chi xac nhan 4 gia tri status va 2 duong chuyen cu the (pending->cancel, approved->cancel); khong co ma tran day du nao duoc cong bo nen khong biet chuyen trang thai nao hop le/bi cam.

open_question_draft.summary: Ma tran chuyen trang thai hop le day du cua Invoice la gi (pending->?, approved->?, completed->?, cancel->?), va code co chan cac chuyen trang thai khong hop le khong?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Vung nay da co 1 known defect (C1); khong co ma tran day du thi QA khong the kiem duoc cac chuyen trang thai bi cam con lai, co the con defect tuong tu chua duoc phat hien.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Thong bao/email khi Invoice chuyen sang approved hoac khi bi cancel tu approved
checks.precondition: Invoice sap chuyen sang approved, hoac sap bi huy tu approved.
steps: Chuyen 1 Invoice sang approved, kiem tra hop thu/thong bao cua affiliate.
Huy 1 Invoice dang approved, kiem tra lai hop thu/thong bao cua affiliate.
checks.observation_point: Email/thong bao (neu co) gui cho affiliate trong 2 tinh huong tren.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - tai lieu chi neu email 'Payment completed' (khi completed) va Slack cho Ops (khi co request moi); im lang ve 2 tinh huong nay. Dac biet quan trong vi day la tinh huong gay mat tien (known defect C1) nhung affiliate co the khong duoc bao gi ca.

open_question_draft.summary: Affiliate co nhan duoc thong bao/email nao khi Invoice chuyen sang approved, hoac khi bi huy tu approved (tinh huong lien quan known defect C1) khong?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Neu affiliate khong duoc bao gi khi bi mat balance do known defect C1, ho se khong biet de lien he Ops doi xu ly - day la 1 phan cua muc do nghiem trong cua defect, can duoc xac nhan.

coverage_by_feature_and_risk.risk_coverage: KNOWN DEFECT C1 (severity CRITICAL) duoc phan anh qua CHK-003 (dimension REGRESSION, oracle_strength BASELINE, priority P1) dung theo chi dan; CHK-004 kiem tra quy trinh bu khuyet thu cong di kem. CHK-007/008/009/010 phan anh dung cac unknown_areas con lai xung quanh vung rui ro nay.

checks_needing_confirmation.open_question_draft: Huy 1 Invoice tu trang thai completed co duoc phep khong, va balance/tien da chi duoc xu ly the nao?
checks_needing_confirmation.reason: Khong co kb_id nao mo ta nhanh chuyen trang thai completed->cancel; day la gap hoan toan.

checks_needing_confirmation.open_question_draft: Affiliate co the tu huy 1 Invoice da approved bang cach goi truc tiep API hay bi middleware chan?
checks_needing_confirmation.reason: Khong co kb_id xac nhan co middleware rieng cho hanh dong huy giong check_can_create_invoice cho hanh dong tao.

checks_needing_confirmation.open_question_draft: Ma tran chuyen trang thai hop le day du cua Invoice la gi?
checks_needing_confirmation.reason: Khong co kb_id nao cong bo ma tran day du, chi co 2 duong chuyen cu the duoc xac nhan.

checks_needing_confirmation.open_question_draft: Affiliate co nhan duoc thong bao/email khi Invoice chuyen sang approved hoac khi bi huy tu approved khong?
checks_needing_confirmation.reason: Khong co kb_id nao xac nhan/phu nhan su ton tai cua thong bao nay.

excluded_dimensions.reason: Hanh dong huy khong co tham so so luong/dinh dang de kiem bien rieng; bien ve tien (vd amount) da duoc test day du o checklist payout-request-submission.
